title: Observability: Cloud Monitoring, Logging, Trace & Profiler — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates latency anomaly breach: demonstrates Cloud Monitoring alerting on p99 SLO burn rate and automated incident escalation to PagerDuty.
routing_rationale: Multi-window multi-burn-rate alerts detect both sudden severe degradations (14x burn in 1 hour) and slow chronic leaks (2x burn in 6 hours) without alert fatigue.

nodes.label: Degraded Payment Pod
nodes.detail: Payment microservice exceeds 500ms SLO latency target for 15% of requests.

nodes.label: MQL Burn Rate Evaluator
nodes.detail: Calculates 2% of 30-day error budget consumed in past 60 minutes.

nodes.label: Cloud Monitoring Incident
nodes.detail: Opens high-severity operational incident; bundles latency graphs and trace IDs.

nodes.label: SRE PagerDuty On-Call
nodes.detail: Pages primary SRE engineer within 60 seconds of confirmed threshold breach.

steps.title: Error Budget Burn Calculation
steps.action: MQL query computes short-window (1h) and long-window (6h) burn rates simultaneously.
steps.why_traversal: Dual-window evaluation prevents false alarms from short transient spikes.

steps.title: Automated Incident Opening
steps.action: 14x burn rate confirmed; Cloud Monitoring opens Incident #89201.
steps.why_traversal: Creates centralized operational timeline for incident retrospective.

steps.title: Targeted On-Call Paging
steps.action: Notification channel pages on-call engineer with direct link to Cloud Trace flame chart.
steps.why_traversal: Reduces MTTR (Mean Time to Resolution) from 45 minutes to 8 minutes.

scenarios.label: Alert Fatigue / Flapping Notification Storm
scenarios.root_cause: Alert configured with simple static CPU threshold (CPU > 80% for 1 minute).
scenarios.diverted_path: 50 alerts fired in 1 hour during normal batch job processing; on-call muted alerts.
scenarios.blast_radius: Real production customer degradation missed during noise storm.
scenarios.recovery: Transition all alerting to SLO error budget burn rate policies using MQL.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Simulates latency anomaly breach: demonstrates Cloud Monitoring alerting on p99 SLO burn rate and automated incident escalation to PagerDuty.
